title: identity taxonomy v2 — canonical-projection edition (v5-response re-review P0-1; owner ruling 1 2026-07-18)
supersession: v2 replaces v1 (dated supersession, same day): v1's reduced schema grew independently of the survey canon and its derived bit was misnamed is_project_strict_identity while covering only weight/label/access bits — a native audio/omni core could never satisfy it (construct absurdity, re-review Round A). v2 projects from canonical fields, splits internal visibility from core I/O modality, adds the load-bearing system axes, and renames derived bits to their mechanical meaning. v1 file retained unmodified for audit.
unit: method_path — one row per method path actually supported by the paper's method/experiment sections; mixed/composed variants (e.g. RTV vs PDR vs combined pipeline) get separate rows and a row never inherits two variants' virtues

canon_projection.principle: no second independent schema: every field below declares the canonical survey field it projects (REC-2 matrix / 13-axis system-control DFS / omni_axes / rl_identity); machine occupancy is a projection of canonical records, not a parallel ontology

map.core_native_modality: REC-2 omni_axes / modality_path（模态是否原生进入核心,非数据集含音频）
map.internal_visibility: REC-2 matrix.core_access 之内部可见性半轴（weights|logits|hidden-state|attention|API）
map.core_io_modality: REC-2 matrix.core_access 之 API-text|API-multimodal 半轴（v1 曾误删 api_multimodal——已恢复）
map.label_axes: 信息边界正典（dev-label ≠ test-gold 三分法）
map.signal_form_source_use: 13-axis DFS axis-8 反馈/奖励来源 的三分投影（Round C:形态/来源/用途拆开）
map.selection_object_terminal_operator: 13-axis DFS axis-9/axis-11（Round B:分析单位不得跨工具池/轨迹池/输出池聚合）

fields.core_topology: enum — single_core / single_core_multi_call(同一冻结核心多角色多次调用) / multi_model_federation(异构多模型) / core_plus_external_model(核心+外部异构 guide/judge 模型)
fields.core_native_modality: enum — text_only / vision_native / audio_native / omni_native / asr_mediated(音频经外部 ASR 转文本,非原生) / unknown
fields.internal_visibility: enum — api_only(仅输入输出接口) / logits_logprob / hidden_state / gradient
fields.signal_form: enum — scalar_score / pairwise_comparison / binary_gate / text_critique / confidence / consensus_vote / verifiable_outcome / none
fields.signal_source: enum — rule / llm_judge / trained_classifier / learned_rm_prm / environment / self_confidence / consensus / human_aligned_proxy / none
fields.signal_use: array ⊆ [select, prune, route, revise, state_update, supply, stop_budget, execute_skip_gate, synthesize_input, train_controller, offline_diagnostic]
fields.decision_rights: array ⊆ [route, retry, branch, tool_call, memory_write, supply, stop, synthesize, execute_skip]（控制器实际拥有的权;空数组=无控制器权）
fields.selection_object: enum — candidate_output / trajectory / action / tool_agent / plan / none
fields.terminal_operator: enum — select_one / prune / route / vote / merge / synthesize / accept_reject / none
fields.explicit_candidate_pool_selection: bool（须与 selection_object≠none 一致,测试强制）
fields.includes_speech_audio: bool — 数据集模态位;明示:**不构成 native omni 证据**（Round A）

derived.all_components_weight_frozen: NOT core_weight_update AND NOT external_component_weight_update（v1 之 is_all_system_training_free 的诚实改名——只声称权重轴）
derived.data_access_strict_bits: all_components_weight_frozen AND 五个标签/信息位全 false AND internal_visibility==api_only（v1 之 is_project_strict_identity 的诚实改名——这只是权重/标签/访问严格位,不是项目身份）
derived.is_reward_guided: signal_form ∈ {scalar_score, pairwise_comparison, verifiable_outcome} AND signal_use ∩ {select, prune, revise} ≠ ∅（Round C:binary_gate/consensus 不因 learned/评价性被归入;consensus 与 confidence 单列追踪）
derived.is_project_identity_candidate: data_access_strict_bits AND core_topology ∈ {single_core, single_core_multi_call} AND core_native_modality ∈ {audio_native, omni_native}（S0/RQ-SYS 投影;unknown 字段一律视为不满足——评审 §8.1）

conflict_rules: dev/calibration/search gold ⇒ label 轴,永不报 test_item_gold_access
mixed-path 论文按 method_path 分行;组合 pipeline 单独成行,不与成分行互借
占据量词必须引用本 taxonomy 测试的持久化合取输出,散文不手数;K 池计数必须按 selection_object 分层报告
trained binary gate(signal_form=binary_gate) 永不编码为 learned_rm_prm;signal_source=trained_classifier
includes_speech_audio=true 不得推出 speech/omni 方法占据;方法占据须 core_native_modality 证成
